concept: On the 5th floor, by the Nihonbashi bridge

WORK STYLING Nihonbashi 1-chome is on the 5th floor of a building directly connected to Nihombashi Station. It is three minutes from Nihombashi Station on the Toei Asakusa Line and six from JR Tokyo Station.
Hourly open space and private rooms share the floor with rental offices taken on the dedicated-space plan (FLEX).
steps: Seats you can take without booking
Reception crew greet you at the 5th-floor entrance.
The open space can be used without booking.
Meeting rooms hold up to 12 people.
Directly connected to Nihombashi Station, it is easy to direct visitors here.
Rooms for one, rooms for teams
Single-person rooms are for calls and online meetings.
Rental offices can be taken as a team base.

word.title: What is a rental office?
body: A room with furniture and connectivity ready, rented by the month. At WORK STYLING this is the dedicated-space plan (FLEX).
Being on the same floor as the shared open space and meeting rooms, you can use facilities outside your room on busy days with visitors and meetings.

title: WORK STYLING Ginza — a shared office open at weekends, on the 9th floor of Ginza Glasse, one minute from Ginza Station
lead: Mitsui Fudosan's WORK STYLING Ginza is on the 9th floor of Ginza Glasse, a one-minute walk from Ginza Station on the Tokyo Metro. It is open from 8:00 to 22:00 on weekdays, weekends and holidays alike, with an open space, meeting rooms for up to 12 and single-person rooms. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Single-person rooms / meeting rooms (up to 12) / open space
1 min from Ginza Sta. (Tokyo Metro) / 3 min from JR Yurakucho Sta. / 5 min from Ginza-itchome Sta.
concept: In the middle of Ginza, at weekends too
WORK STYLING Ginza is on the 9th floor of Ginza Glasse, a minute from Ginza Station and three from JR Yurakucho Station.

Its distinguishing feature is opening from 8:00 to 22:00 not only on weekdays but on weekends and holidays. In Ginza, where people gather to shop and eat, you can slip in some work time at the weekend.
steps: Seats you can take without booking
The open space can be used without booking.
There is a drinks corner, and chargers and stationery to borrow.
Meeting rooms hold up to 12 people.
One minute from Ginza Station, it is easy to direct visitors here.
Single-person rooms are for calls and online meetings.
Separate phone booths are also available.

word.title: What is a phone booth?
body: A small enclosed seat for making calls or joining online meetings alone. Your voice doesn't carry, and the open space stays quiet.
WORK STYLING Ginza has phone booths in addition to single-person rooms: booths for short calls, rooms for longer meetings.

name: WORK STYLING Shiodome City Center 5F
card: “INDUSTRY+FOREST” — a station-like entrance and lots of greenery
title: WORK STYLING Shiodome City Center — “INDUSTRY+FOREST”, with a station-like entrance and greenery, on the 5th floor of Shiodome City Center
lead: Mitsui Fudosan's WORK STYLING Shiodome City Center 5F is on the 5th floor of Shiodome City Center. Its design concept is “INDUSTRY+FOREST”: an entrance like a railway station and a design rich in greenery. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Single-person rooms / meeting rooms (up to 12 and 13–80) / open space / rental offices
concept: INDUSTRY+FOREST

The design concept of WORK STYLING Shiodome City Center 5F is “INDUSTRY+FOREST”. Making use of the building's narrow, deep floor plate, it adopted a station-like entrance and a green design reminiscent of projects that turn disused railway lines into parks, the website says.

It is a one-minute walk from Shiodome Station on the Toei Oedo Line and three from the Shiodome exit of JR Shimbashi Station. SHARE is open 8:00–21:00 on weekdays, and FLEX members, including rental offices, can enter 24 hours.
steps: An entrance like a railway station
The entrance is designed to recall a station building.
Reception crew greet you, and the floor stretches out along the building's narrow, deep shape.
Greenery recalling a disused railway turned park
The open space has a green design reminiscent of reused railway lines.
It can be used without booking, and you can choose from several kinds of seating.
There are meeting rooms for up to 12 and rooms for 13–80 people.
Rental offices can be entered 24 hours and taken as a team base.

word.title: What is INDUSTRY+FOREST?
body: The design concept of WORK STYLING Shiodome City Center 5F, combining a station-like entrance (INDUSTRY) with a green design (FOREST).
The greenery, the website says, recalls examples of disused railway lines given new life.

1 min from Shimbashi Sta. (Tokyo Metro) / 2 min from Shimbashi Sta. (JR, Toei, Yurikamome)

WORK STYLING Shimbashi is on the 2nd floor of Shimbashi M-SQUARE, one minute from the Tokyo Metro station and two from the JR, Toei and Yurikamome stations.
Most of the photos on the official site show the open space, which can be used without booking.
steps: Seats you can take without booking
The open space can be used without booking.
There are many kinds of seating, so you can choose where to sit according to the day's work.
Meeting rooms hold up to 12 people.
One minute from Shimbashi Station, it is easy to direct visitors here.
Single-person rooms are for calls and online meetings.

word.title: What is an open space?
body: Shared work seating without partitions. At WORK STYLING, the open space can be used without booking.
With sofas, counters and large tables, you can sit differently in the same place depending on the work at hand.

Open space / meeting rooms (up to 12) / single-person rooms
Weekdays 8:00–21:00 (closed weekends, holidays and New Year)
concept: Two minutes from two stations
WORK STYLING Hamamatsucho is a two-minute walk from both Hamamatsucho and Daimon stations — four lines in all: JR, Tokyo Monorail, Toei Asakusa and Toei Oedo.
Register it as your home site and you can use the open space without booking. Single-person rooms and meeting rooms are booked in 10-minute units.
steps: Shared space you can use without booking
Through the 3rd-floor entrance, the open space spreads out.
The open space at your home site needs no booking, and there is a drinks corner and equipment to borrow.
Meeting rooms hold up to 12 people and can be booked in 10-minute units.
Choose a room to suit the size of your meeting.
Single-person rooms are for online meetings and focused work.
There are also phone booths you can use without booking.

word.title: What is a home site?
body: At WORK STYLING, the site a member registers as their usual base. The website says: “You can use the open space at your home site without booking.”
Make Hamamatsucho your home site and you have a seat two minutes from the station, no booking needed.

facts: 3 min from exit A3 of Omotesando Sta. (Tokyo Metro Ginza, Chiyoda, Hanzomon lines)
Open space / meeting rooms (up to 12) / single-person rooms
concept: An Omotesando base open at night and at weekends
WORK STYLING Omotesando is open until 22:30 on weekdays (21:00 on Wednesdays), and its big feature is opening 10:00–18:00 on weekends and holidays too.
It uses two floors, the 4th and 8th, of the Miyahiro Building in Kita-Aoyama 3-chome, three minutes from exit A3 of Omotesando Station.
steps: Seats you can take without booking
The entrance leads into the open space.
The open space at your home site needs no booking — drop in for a little work in the evening or at the weekend.
Meeting rooms hold up to 12 people.
In Omotesando and Aoyama, they serve as a place to meet visitors.
Rooms to shut the door and focus
Single-person rooms are for calls, online meetings and focused work.
Open late on weekdays, they suit meetings with people in other time zones.

word.title: Which exit should I use?
body: Use exit A3 of Omotesando Station for WORK STYLING Omotesando. The official route guide shows, with photos, how to climb the A3 stairs, turn at the Omotesando crossing, walk along Aoyama-dori and enter the Miyahiro Building.
From exit A3 it is a three-minute walk.

concept: Pay as you go, on the east side of Shibuya Station

WORK STYLING Shibuya is on the 3rd floor of the Shibuya Park Building, four minutes from the East Exit — a short walk east from Shibuya Station, where JR, Keio Inokashira, Tokyu and Tokyo Metro lines meet.
On SHARE, the pay-as-you-go plan, you pay only for the time you use. Meeting rooms and private rooms are booked separately.
steps: Seats you can take without booking
Through the entrance is the open space.
The open space at your home site needs no booking, with a drinks and café corner and equipment to borrow.
Meeting rooms hold up to 12 people.
Close to Shibuya Station, they work well for meeting people from outside.
Single-person rooms are used by booking.
They suit online meetings and calls you'd rather take away from others.

word.title: What is SHARE?
body: WORK STYLING's pay-as-you-go plan: pay only for the time you use and work from sites across the network.
Meeting rooms and private rooms are charged separately and booked. It suits using a site near a station like Shibuya only when you need it.

1 min from Shibuya Sta. (JR, Tokyo Metro, Tokyu) / 4 min from Shibuya Sta. (Keio Inokashira)
Open space (up to 108) / meeting rooms (up to 12) / single-person rooms / rental offices
concept: A shared space for up to 108 people

The website says: “In addition to a shared open space for up to 108 people, secure private rooms and meeting rooms are available as options.” It is a base with a large shared space, one minute's walk from Shibuya Station.
Listed on the website as open on weekends and holidays, it is open 10:00–18:00 on those days. Along with single-person rooms and meeting rooms for up to 12, there are rental offices for teams.
steps: A shared space for up to 108
The entrance leads into an open space that holds up to 108 people.
The open space at your home site needs no booking. The photos show many kinds of seating.
Meeting rooms for up to 12, and rooms for one
Meeting rooms hold up to 12 people.
Single-person rooms are for online meetings and focused time.
Rooms that become a team's base
Rental offices can be taken as a team's base.
There is also a lounge for a break outside your room.

word.title: Which WORK STYLING sites open at weekends?
body: The WORK STYLING website marks sites that are open on weekends and holidays. Shibuya Sakura Stage is open 8:00–21:00 on weekdays and 10:00–18:00 on weekends and holidays.
It is in unit 201 on the 2nd floor of the SAKURA Side. Look for that unit number so you don't confuse it with other workplaces in the same complex.
